description: In these excitation systems, voltage (and also current in compounded systems) is transformed to an appropriate level. Rectifiers, either controlled or non-controlled, provide the necessary direct current for the generator field. Parameters of IEEE Std 421.5 Type ST6B Excitacion System. ST6B in PSSE and PSLF

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component

base_power.description: Base power for this model's per-unit parameters. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the dynamic injection that names this model; the ingestion layer reconciles a difference. Units: MVA.

OEL_Flag.description: OEL Flag for ST6B: 1: before HV gate, 2: after HV gate

T_da.description: Voltage regulator derivative channel time constant

K_ff.description: Pre-control gain of the inner loop field regulator

K_m.description: Forward gain of the inner loop field regulator

K_ci.description: Exciter output current limit adjustment gain

Kg.description: Feedback gain constant of the inner loop field regulator

Tg.description: Feedback time constant of the inner loop field voltage regulator

title: ST6B
